name: 90290 · Topanga, CA
findings: ZIP 90290 (Topanga) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90290 (Topanga) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90290 (Topanga) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
